SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
RLG.S.
D. 2156

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of anonymous letter.

December 11, 1935.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
Chin Yu Jen having printed a good number of obscene books is engaged in the secret sale of them in the lodging houses and theatres in the Settlement which is against public morals and injurious to the youth. His conduct must be condemned. On the night of Saturday last while I and my son and daughter were witnessing a show in the Lyric Theatre (Peking Road), the aforesaid Chin sold several obscene books to my son. This was not discovered until we returned home. Yesterday I was invited by a friend of mine to witness a play at the Ta Hu Tai Theatre and on leaving it, I met Chin again selling obscene books which he carried in his hand. On the pretense of buying his books I learned that he is a shroff of the Ta Chung Book Store, No. 320 Foochow Road. To check this up, I called at the book store to-day when I saw him there. Under these circumstances I forward for your information an obscene book, enclosed herewith, requesting you to be good enough to suppress it in accordance with law.

(Signed): Sheng Ping?
A citizen.

Translator's note: The book enclosed contains three stories of sex-ual intercourse described in indecent language.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
RLG.S.
D. 2156

总巡官办公室。

匿名信译文。

1935年12月11日。

致
上海公共租界工部局
警务处总巡官。

先生：
金玉仁（Chin Yu Jen，音译）印制了大量淫秽书籍，并在租界内的旅馆和戏院秘密售卖，此举有伤风化，毒害青年。其行为必须予以谴责。上周六晚，我与子女在丽都大戏院（Lyric Theatre，位于南京路）观看演出时，上述金玉仁向我儿子出售了几本淫秽书籍。我们回家后才发觉此事。昨日，我应友人之邀去大舞台（Ta Hu Tai，音译）看戏，离场时又遇见金玉仁手持淫秽书籍进行售卖。我假意购买其书籍，得知他是福州路320号大众书局（Ta Chung Book Store）的收银员。为核实此事，我今日前往该书店，果然见他在那里。鉴于上述情况，现随函附呈一本淫秽书籍供贵处查考，恳请依法予以查禁。

署名：盛平？（Sheng Ping?，音译）
一市民。

译者注：所附书籍包含三个以猥亵语言描述性交的故事。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 111.C.
D.
S. 5, Special Branch, SHANGHAI
REPORT
Date February 20, 1936.

Subject Alleged Sale of Indecent Books in Local Theatres.
Subject Alleged Sale of Indecent Books in local theatres
Made by C.A. Loh Sih Kya. Forwarded by Chihmoore to S.P.
Loh Sih Kya Forwarded by Hamooden

Sir,

For the past two months C.D.S. 96 has paid frequent
visits to the Lyric Theatre, No.780 Peking Road, the Ta Wu Tan
Theatre, No.663 Kiukiang Road, and several other theatres and
amusement places to locate the man Ching Wei Jen (經惠人)
who is alleged by the writer of attached anonymous letter to
be selling obscene books in theatres.
Enquiries made at the Ta Chung Bookstore (大衆書局),
No.320 Foochow Road, show that a man named Ching Wei Jen
is actually in the employ of the shop in question. Attempts
made to purchase indecent books from him have proved unsuccessful.

Van Chien Kong (樊劍剛), Manager of the Ta Chung
Bookstore, was interviewed and he declared that, being a member
of the Executive Committee of the Shanghai Bookstore Keepers'
Association, he would never permit his shop to sell indecent
books and assured the undersigned that Ching Wei Jen is an
honest man and would never go to theatres to sell indecent
books.

Loh Sih Kya
Clerical Assistant.

D. C. (Special Branch).

File
21 FEB. 1936

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 111.C.
D.
S. 5，上海特别支部
报告
日期：1936年2月20日。

事由：据称在当地戏院售卖淫秽书籍。
事由：据称在当地戏院售卖淫秽书籍
由罗思嘉（Loh Sih Kya，音译）撰写。由 Chihmoore（音译）转交特别巡捕房。
罗思嘉（Loh Sih Kya，音译）由 Hamooden（音译）转交

先生：

过去两个月内，刑事侦缉处第96号警探频繁走访位于南京路780号的丽都大戏院（Lyric Theatre）、九江路663号的大舞台（Ta Wu Tan，音译）以及其他几家戏院和娱乐场所，以查找经惠人（Ching Wei Jen），即附呈匿名信作者指控在戏院售卖淫秽书籍之人。
经向福州路320号大众书局（Ta Chung Bookstore）查询，证实确有一名名为经惠人的受雇于该店。试图从其手中购买淫秽书籍的尝试均未成功。

已约谈大众书局经理樊剑刚（Van Chien Kong），他声明，作为上海书业同业公会执行委员会成员，他绝不允许其店铺售卖淫秽书籍，并向本人保证经惠人是一位诚实的人，绝不会去戏院售卖淫秽书籍。

罗思嘉（Loh Sih Kya，音译）
文书助理。

D. C. （特别支部）。

档案
1936年2月21日
